stances_toward.note: Review 2026-10-12: regraded from rival to reluctant_partner; the Milei-Sanchez spat (ambassador withdrawn 2024) is personal and ideological, with no opposition of structural aims between Spain and Argentina (investment, migration, Mercosur, the Ibero-American frame all pull together), so the grade follows the structure. A personal and ideological spat, not a strategic one: Milei called Sanchez's wife 'corrupt' at a Vox event in Madrid (May 2024), Spain withdrew its ambassador 'definitively' on 21 May 2024, Milei refused to apologise and did not reciprocate. A 2025 repeat insult is reported but the current ambassador status could not be confirmed. Economic ties (Spanish investment in Argentina) continue. Rival, because of the sustained friction; no source uses the word (C). Bond - kin (language, migration).

stances_toward.note: Argentina claims the Falklands and has not abandoned the claim: Milei told the Telegraph in Dec 2025 that talks on arms-export controls had begun (the Foreign Office denied it), reaffirmed the claim in April 2026 and at the UN in Sep 2026; London repeats that sovereignty 'is not up for negotiation' (99.8% of islanders voted to remain in 2013). The 2026 twist is a leaked Pentagon email suggesting a US review of its position in retaliation for Britain's stance on Iran, then a State Department statement of 'neutrality'. Milei is friendly to Britain in tone; the grade follows the claim, not the tone. Bond - grievance: 1982 war.
